name: word-roller-perspective-stripes
title: Word Roller Perspective Stripes
description: Rows of a two-part phrase in two colours slide sideways at different speeds over a tilted plane that scrolls away in depth, while the phrase itself fades up large in the middle.
useWhen: A title over a moving wall of repeated text: a slogan, a call to action, a repeated claim.
A dynamic backdrop that needs the message to stay readable in front.
avoidWhen: The message has to be read in the rows themselves: they are small and busy.
author: lifeprompt-team
